rules: zh = a Chinese name for a catalogue table, printed in a page's source line in place of the table's English title; the table id stays beside it.
Only names the project owner reviewed are listed (zh_source 'reviewed', with the review date); a name is never machine-translated into this file.
A table with no entry keeps its English title as the catalogue lists it.
